title: Warmly Spiced American Knafeh Casserole
description: A salty, juicy, lazy-Sunday American dish featuring knafeh, soffritto-base, and lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the soffritto over medium heat until fragrant.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, shredded mozzarella, spinach, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Unroll the knafeh dough and cut it into 1-inch pieces.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of knafeh dough pieces.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the knafeh dough layer.
Repeat the layers, starting with the knafeh dough, then the remaining ricotta cheese mixture, and finally another layer of knafeh dough.
Bake the casserole for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
